name: Daisuke Okanohara
bio: Daisuke Okanohara is a co-founder of Preferred Networks and its chief operating officer; the company grew out of Preferred Infrastructure, founded in 2006. Preferred Networks developed the Chainer deep learning framework and the MN-Core accelerator. Okanohara is an author of the PLaMo-100B report on a Japanese-focused language model.
